scientific_queries.note: Unseen-combination test on data in hand; no novelty claim.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round's finding is a dissociation that is reported with both metrics and the untreated confound (membership vs fine structure) named.

design.model: y = mu + a_A + a_B, ridge lambda = 1.0 fixed (no tuning)
design.loo: exact via the hat-matrix identity resid_loo_i = e_i / (1 - H_ii)

decisions.H054_status: not assessable - coverage is nearly constant (36-76), so the tercile split collapses and the test has no information

headline: the bulk ordering of an unseen compound pair is almost perfectly additive (rho 0.941), while the ten most effective pairs are largely not (precision@10 0.225, 7.8x chance); the two metrics are uncorrelated within units (corr -0.02), so additivity explains the level and the interaction lives in the tail
not_claimed: this is an unseen COMBINATION (both compounds seen elsewhere), NOT an unseen drug; the unseen-drug question remains untestable in this archive (F2/F5)
confound_not_treated: part of rho may come from membership (a potent compound makes all its pairs low) rather than fine structure; that decomposition was not run

register_updates.C19: new, exploratory: unseen combination additive rho 0.941 vs precision@10 0.225, uncorrelated
